name: Yelp2018

pilot.evaluation_protocol: full ranking over all items not in the user's training set; Recall@20, NDCG@20
pilot.negative_source: implicit: all items the user has not interacted with in train
pilot.rule_found_in_code_or_release: the release is a 10-core internally (min user degree 18, min item degree 10); 0 test interactions on items or users absent from train
pilot.rule_stated_in_paper: 2018 Yelp challenge, same 10-core setting; the revised version also removes cold-start items from the test set
pilot.sources_checked: NGCF Sec. 4.1.1 and footnote 2; LightGCN Sec. 4; kuandeng/LightGCN Data/yelp2018
pilot.verification: release-internal checks only; the 2018 challenge file is not public and the current Yelp Open Dataset requires accepting its terms (not done)

why_no_card: The raw Yelp data can only be downloaded after accepting Yelp's dataset terms, so no universe has been built. The pilot checked the release internally.
